profile.headline: Enterprise Systems Analyst and ZOS Developer - ETL Legacy to ERP
profile.summary:
Strong technical and business skills add value in the manufacturing workplace.  From the shop floor to the board room, able to analyze business needs and objectives to create long term value added solutions.  Technology development and support ERP in Windows Server, SQL Server, Z/OS , DB2.

High level of technical expertise in programming , JCL and utilities in ZOS.

positions.title: Busines systems Analyst - Supply Chain
positions.description:
Responsibilities: 
•	Support existing infrastructure 
•	Review new business requests and create recommendations for management
•	Recommend best practices to management
•	Prepare detail specifications for projects approved by management

positions.description: Nissan supply chain systems support their dealer network (known as Aftersales) with a legacy platform running under ZOS with a network of distribution centers across the US, Mexico and Canada.

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst
positions.description: Support the world wide systems of Ford Motor Credit Company. IBM Z/OS network of multiple mainframe , AS400 and Server applications. Extensive responsibility in managing the release of new and updated systems used in the global platform of Ford Credit. Growing responsibility in the upgrade of DB2 based systems to a global Unicode standard. Design, program , implement and support Unicode DB2 applications.
